description: Find a person's work e-mail address, other contact details and current job from their public profile link, an e-mail address, or their name and company. Uses one lookup credit when an e-mail address is found, nothing otherwise.

company.description: the company the person works for; use together with name

email.description: an e-mail address the person is known by

include_phone.description: also look for a mobile number; this uses extra credits and is off unless set

name.description: the person's full name; use together with company when there is no profile link or e-mail

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile page (a link with /in/ and the person's handle in it)

name: find_contact_details

company_is_current.description: false when the employer shown may no longer be current

status.description: how sure we are the address is deliverable (verified, likely, unverified, risky)

domain.description: the employer's website domain, when known

not_offered_emails.description: addresses held but not offered as current, with the reason

reason.description: why it is not offered: left_employer, other_employer or undeliverable

number.description: the phone number in international format

profile_url.description: link to the person's public professional profile

credits_left.description: lookup credits left on the account after this call

credits_used.description: lookup credits this call used; 0 when the answer was already stored

crm.description: the name of the customer's connected CRM; absent when none is connected

phone_lookup.description: found, none (looked for, no number exists) or unknown (not looked for)

title: Find contact details
